description.en: COCOTree evaluates open tree-structured visual decomposition, segmenting images into hierarchical trees of visual components with unconstrained granularity. It includes over 21K images and 1.8M structural nodes, with 3.5K unique labels, and uses the Open Tree Quality (OTQ) metric for scoring.
